cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,importlib.util
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
d=json.load(open('examples/endpoint-cycle.input.json'))
ixps,rib,pr,de,order,qs=s.validate(d)
agg={};allE=set()
for raw,c in rib:
 p=s.normalize_path(raw,ixps)
 if len(p)<2 or len(set(p))!=len(p):continue
 agg[p]=agg.get(p,0)+c
for p in agg:
 for a,b in zip(p,p[1:]):allE.add(s.canonical(a,b))
rounds,cp,core=s.peel(agg);cl=sorted(core);ei={e:i for i,e in enumerate(cl)}
sc,occ=s.build_scopes_and_occurrences(cp,ei);pos=s.validate_order_and_width(order,cl,sc);f=s.make_factors(len(cl),sc,occ)
Z=s.run_ve(f,len(cl),pos);print('Z',Z)
PY
